correctness.rationale: Exact exhaustive reconstruction yields 1,813 faces and a 841-pair acyclic matching, verified over all 5,550 covers; critical cells (1 in degree 0, 83 in degree 2, 47 in degree 3). Independent original simplicial boundary ranks over 2,3,5,13 corroborate. The no-one-cell CW model and Hurewicz imply wedge of 36 2-spheres plus degree-26 Moore space. Actual packaged verifier returned VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: The Paley-37 graph is a canonical next prime-size symmetric graph after the previously computed Paley-29 case. The discovered odd prime 13 in integral H2 is new information beyond known Euler characteristic 37, known H1 vanishing and P29 two-torsion; it gives a complete integral homotopy classification of a natural graph/flag-complex invariant, useful for comparing torsion behavior of Paley complexes. This is not merely a face-count recomputation or a numerical parameter substitution: the previously known P29 result does not determine the 26-degree Moore attachment.
